correctness.rationale: Let T=A+iB with A,B self-adjoint on any nonzero complex Hilbert space and |A|=aP, P orthogonal projection. For δ=||( |T|−|A| )_+||, positive S=|T| obeys S≤aP+δI, ||S||≤a+δ and S²≤||S||S. Taking approximate eigenvectors of B at λ=±||B||, the cross term in ||(A+iλ)x||² vanishes and A²=a²P, yielding ||B||²≤a(||S||−a)⟨Px,x⟩+||S||δ≤2aδ+δ². Works without eigenvalue or commutativity assumptions. For prescribed δ=ε, B=sqrt(2aε+ε²)P attains equality for any fixed a>0,A; a=0 choose B=εI. Includes ε=0 and infinite-dimensional spectral boundary. No claim of an equality classification among arbitrary nonnormal B.

The general exact Fong–Tsui theorem treats ε=0 only; partial-isometry-of-T results differ from A²=a²P. The prior sharp normal class excludes nonnormal T.
